title: #029. Disjunctive Operating Bands (Convex Hull)
subtitle: Formulate disjoint operating regimes with band-specific fixed and linear costs via disaggregated convex-hull variables.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { modes, outputs, totalCost }.
judge.m1: modes[{p0}] must be a valid integer band index (received {p1}).
judge.m2: Unit {p0} output ({p1}) falls outside band {p2} range [{p3}, {p4}].
judge.m3: Total output ({p0}) is below required demand ({p1}).
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed fixed plus linear band cost ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid dispatch, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
